chars.SAAD: SAAD: a skinny teenage boy wearing a bright yellow hoodie, black skinny jeans and white sneakers, holding a big black DSLR camera with a strap around his neck.
chars.NADA: NADA: a teenage girl wearing a lilac puffer jacket over a white top, light blue jeans and a pink headscarf.
chars.THUG1: THUG1: a rough young man wearing a red bucket hat, a faded stretched grey t-shirt, baggy dark green surf shorts and cheap black plastic pool sandals on dusty feet.
chars.THUG2: THUG2: a rough young man wearing a black tracksuit with white stripes and a black cap, sitting on a small old red motor scooter.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a quiet empty street of a rich villa neighborhood in Casablanca, Morocco (white villas, palm trees, bougainvillea on walls), SAAD crouches proudly taking a photo of NADA with his camera; NADA poses smiling against a villa wall. Sunny afternoon.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Same Casablanca villa street. SAAD shows NADA the photo on the back screen of his camera; NADA leans in, delighted and impressed. SAAD looks proud and confident.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Wide shot of a long empty silent street lined with closed villa gates and palm trees in Casablanca; SAAD and NADA are small in the middle of the street, alone, doing the photoshoot. Nobody else around, a few birds on a wire.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: In the empty Casablanca villa street, the small red motor scooter driven by THUG2 with THUG1 sitting behind him slowly stops at the curb; both stare ahead with cold suspicious looks.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Casablanca villa street. In the foreground SAAD lowers his camera and NADA stands close behind him, both uneasy. In the background THUG1 and THUG2 get off the scooter and walk slowly toward them.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Low-angle shot in the Casablanca villa street: THUG1 walks forward slowly with a menacing look, his cheap pool sandals slapping the pavement, hands in his pockets.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Casablanca villa street. THUG2 leans on his small old red motor scooter, arms crossed, staring with a cold smirk.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Casablanca villa street. THUG1 and THUG2 stand side by side next to the small red scooter, looking straight ahead with threatening expressions, the empty street behind them.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot in the Casablanca villa street: SAAD clutches his camera to his chest, sweating and frightened; NADA grabs his sleeve, scared, both looking toward something off to the side.
